## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

**2026-06-24 — OpenAI/Broadcom: Jalapeño LLM inference chip**  
Link: https://openai.com/index/openai-broadcom-jalapeno-inference-chip/  
Summary: OpenAI and Broadcom announced Jalapeño, a custom chip optimized for LLM inference. OpenAI says engineering samples are running ML workloads in-lab at target production frequency and power, including GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark workloads.  
Why it matters: This is vertical integration into inference silicon. If production metrics hold, it could reduce OpenAI’s dependence on merchant accelerators and improve cost/performance at scale.

**2026-06-24 — Samsung Electronics deploys ChatGPT and Codex internally**  
Link: https://openai.com/index/samsung-electronics-chatgpt-codex-deployment/  
Summary: Samsung Electronics plans to deploy ChatGPT and Codex across technical and non-technical functions, including software development, marketing, product development, and manufacturing.  
Why it matters: Large enterprise adoption by a semiconductor and electronics manufacturer is a signal for broader use of coding agents and general assistants inside industrial workflows.

**2026-06-24 — OpenAI publishes Codex long-running work guidance**  
Link: https://openai.com/index/codex-maxxing-long-running-work/  
Summary: OpenAI published a whitepaper on using Codex as a persistent workspace for long-running projects, with emphasis on maintaining context and steering complex workflows.  
Why it matters: The emphasis is shifting from single-turn code generation toward sustained agentic engineering workflows.

## 2. FOSS / Open-weight LMs & Tools

**2026-06-24 — Qwen releases Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B**  
Link: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B  
Summary: Qwen released an Apache-2.0 open-weight 35B-total / 3B-active model trained to simulate agent environments across MCP, search, terminal, SWE, Android, web, and OS domains. The release includes AgentWorldBench and quick-start paths for Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang.  
Why it matters: Agent evaluation and training increasingly need controllable simulated environments. This release targets the infrastructure layer for testing and improving autonomous agents.
